masters.verification.submitted.title: Profile submitted for verification
masters.verification.submitted.body: We will check your documents, categories and service area and let you know the result.

masters.verification.verified.title: Profile verified
masters.verification.verified.body: Congratulations! You now receive requests in your feed for the confirmed categories and area.

masters.verification.rejected.title: Verification rejected
masters.verification.rejected.body: Reason: {{reason}}. Fix the profile and submit it again.

masters.verification.revoked.title: Verification revoked
masters.verification.revoked.body: Your feed access is closed. You can apply again with new documents from {{reverificationAllowedFrom}}.

masters.verification.restored.title: Verification restored
masters.verification.restored.body: The sanction was lifted, your profile is verified again.

masters.category.verified.title: Category confirmed
masters.category.verified.body: Your qualification in the category is confirmed.

masters.category.rejected.title: Category rejected
masters.category.rejected.body: Your qualification in the category was not confirmed. Reason: {{reason}}.

masters.service-area.verified.title: Service area confirmed
masters.service-area.verified.body: You will receive requests from the confirmed area.

masters.service-area.rejected.title: Service area rejected
masters.service-area.rejected.body: Reason: {{reason}}. Change the area and submit the profile again.

masters.verification-hold.placed.title: Verification on hold
masters.verification-hold.placed.body: Verification is on hold until a human check. Reason: {{reason}}.

masters.verification-hold.released.title: Check completed
masters.verification-hold.released.body: The verification hold was released, the review of your profile continues.

masters.sanction.applied.title: Sanction applied
masters.sanction.applied.body: A sanction was applied to your profile: {{kind:t}}. Valid until: {{expiresAt:t}}. You can appeal the decision.

masters.sanction.lifted.title: Sanction lifted
masters.sanction.lifted.body: The sanction "{{kind:t}}" was lifted from your profile.

masters.upload.completed.title: File accepted
masters.upload.completed.body: The file "{{fileName}}" ({{purpose:t}}) was checked and added to your profile.

masters.upload.failed.title: File rejected
masters.upload.failed.body: The file "{{fileName}}" ({{purpose:t}}) was not accepted. Reason: {{reason}}.
